title: Connect-O-Tron: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Gadget state: OFF to ON
scenes.purpose: Show the invented gadget's initial OFF state, then trigger it so the idea fires out as loose nodes.
visuals: Wide shot in deep-violet space with planet and ground
Connect-O-Tron with grey emitter, dim bulb and grey lamps
assets: Canvas 2D procedural cel drawings (no bitmap assets)

beats.development: Initial OFF state held: dim bulb, grey emitter, empty sky to the right.
Idea bulb lights in three stepped cel stages with rays.
Trigger: body kicks back, emitter and lamps switch to active colour, label flips to ON, stepped beam fires and four pink idea nodes pop in unconnected.

scenes.title: Reaction cut
scenes.purpose: One strong reaction: hard cut to the robot close-up, axis kept with gadget light spilling from screen-left.
visuals: Close-up of the same robot drawing at 3.4x
Yellow gadget light wedge from the left
Static toon shock lines and '!' burst in the hard pose

beats.development: Neutral robot pose held for three frames before the hit.
Hard pose swap: eyes widen, mouth O, brows and antenna shoot up, hop, shock lines and '!' burst; pink node reflections in eyes.

scenes.title: Return to the altered prop
scenes.purpose: Cut back to the wide: the loose nodes are now a connected system and the approved caption lands.
visuals: Zigzag yellow links draw between nodes in six steps
Caption bubble with tail toward the gadget dome

beats.development: Links draw node to node; caption bubble scales in, text appears only once the bubble is complete (2.02 s).
Signal pulses run along every link; beam relaxes; nodes gain a connected glow.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM!

beats.development: Settled hold: outline boil frozen, all motion stopped, caption fully legible.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM!

findings: Gadget trigger lands by 0.54 s, reaction hit at 1.1 s, altered prop returns at 1.6 s: one clear action-reaction-result chain.
Caption text readable from 2.02 s to 3.0 s (~0.98 s); motion settled by 2.56 s.
justifiedHolds: 0.0-0.3 s initial OFF state so the change is legible.
1.0-1.1 s neutral beat before the hard reaction pose.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects, narration or subtitles.
